title: Candy Cane Tree
body:
The Candy Cane Tree is a limited-time tree that was added in v1.45.0, replacing all of the trees that would normally spawn in a meteor crash site. The tree was reintroduced in v1.71.0 as a limited time tree that spawned around the map.

Christmas events after v1.71.0 include the Spearmint Candycane Tree which is *slightly* rarer. It has a green appearance and sells for about 674 ❄️ more than the Red Candycane tree. (Logged)

Details

The Candy Cane Tree is a large curving tree with no leaves. Its durability is similar to that of a Magma Tree when struck by any axe. However, if the Festive Axe is used to cut the Candy Cane Tree, it gains an Emberbane-like effect where it can chop the tree in only a few hits.

Sanded and planked Candy Cane has a deep pink hue similar to Red Maple.

Trivia

  • (v1.45.x) When hovered over, the name of the wood appears as "candy_cane", as the string was not properly localized at the time.
